title: A calmer everyday inbox
summary: A first look at OrionMail: connected conversations, useful message actions, and an inbox that works at your pace.

items.title: Conversations and composing
items.text: Read linked replies together. Reply, reply all, forward attachments, or start a fresh message to a sender.

items.title: Pins, tags and snooze
items.text: Pin important messages, manage tags, and snooze Inbox conversations with preset or custom return times.

items.title: Notification controls
items.text: Choose alert folders, Windows tones, Important-only alerts, Do not disturb, and scheduled quiet hours.

items.title: Your workspace
items.text: Preview interface themes and accent colors, customize reading preferences, and edit signatures from Settings or Compose.

items.title: Everyday navigation
items.text: Return from Settings without rebuilding the inbox. Open email links directly in OrionMail and register it as a Windows mail app.

items.title: A cleaner reader
items.text: Quoted reply history stays tucked away, and simple conversation messages blend into their cards in dark mode.

items.title: Clearer sign-in
items.text: Browser sign-in explains the connection status and brings OrionMail forward after a successful connection.

items.title: Device-local organization
items.text: Pins and snoozes are saved per account on this device. Snooze does not sync to Gmail; overdue mail returns when OrionMail next runs.

items.title: Preview release
items.text: Automatic updates are not configured yet. Release notes and this tour are supplied by local versioned release files.

whatsNew.title: Every reply, in its place.
whatsNew.text: Follow linked replies in a tidy conversation. Reply, reply all, or forward the message you choose without losing your place.

image.alt: Three connected message cards with the newest reply expanded.

whatsNew.title: Useful details, ready to go.
whatsNew.text: Verification codes, meeting links, and delivery details appear as Smart Actions above the message, ready when you need them.

image.alt: A Smart Actions card displaying a verification code and a copy control.

whatsNew.title: Make room for focus.
whatsNew.text: Schedule quiet hours or snooze an Inbox conversation until later. Your mail keeps syncing while alerts take a break.

image.alt: A quiet-hours schedule from 22:00 to 08:00 beside a snoozed message card.
